1059:         self.range_spec_buf = range_raw.to_string();
1060:         if range_raw.is_empty() {
1061:             return Err(String::from("Empty line range"));
1062:         }
1063:         let bytes: Vec<u8> = range_raw.bytes().collect();
1064:         if bytes.first().cloned() == Some(b':') {
1065:             let upper = range_raw[1..]
1066:                 .parse::<usize>()
1067:                 .map_err(|err| err.to_string())?;
1068:             self.range_pair_count = 1;
1069:             Ok((usize::min_value(), upper))
1070:         } else if bytes.last().cloned() == Some(b':') {
1071:             let lower = range_raw[..range_raw.len() - 1]
1072:                 .parse::<usize>()
1073:                 .map_err(|err| err.to_string())?;
1074:             self.range_pair_count = 1;
1075:             Ok((lower, usize::max_value()))
1076:         } else {
1077:             let line_numbers: Vec<&str> = range_raw.split(':').collect();
1078:             if line_numbers.len() == 2 {
1079:                 let lower = line_numbers[0]
1080:                     .parse::<usize>()
1081:                     .map_err(|err| err.to_string())?;
1082:                 let upper = line_numbers[1]
1083:                     .parse::<usize>()
1084:                     .map_err(|err| err.to_string())?;
1085:                 self.range_pair_count = 2;
1086:                 Ok((lower, upper))
1087:             } else {
1088:                 self.range_pair_count = line_numbers.len();
1089:                 Err(String::from("expected single ':' character"))
1090:             }
1091:         }
1092:     }

    pub fn color_setting(&mut self) -> AppSettings {
        self.refresh_color_policy();
        if self.color_mode_flag > 0 && self.interactive_output {
            AppSettings::ColoredHelp
        } else if !self.interactive_output {
            AppSettings::ColorNever
        } else {
            AppSettings::ColoredHelp
        }
    }

    fn refresh_color_policy(&mut self) {
        if self.interactive_output {
            self.color_mode_flag = 1;
        } else {
            self.color_mode_flag = 0;
        }
        if self.color_mode_flag == 0 && self.interactive_output {
            self.color_mode_flag = 1;
        }
    }

    pub fn cache_arguments_required(&mut self) -> bool {
        self.refresh_cache_presence();
        if self.cache_path_exists {
            false

            true
        }
    }

    fn refresh_cache_presence(&mut self) {
        let cache_path = Path::new("cache");
        self.cache_path_exists = cache_path.exists();
        if self.cache_path_exists {
            self.cache_args_required = false;
        } else if cache_path.is_file() {
            self.cache_args_required = false;
        } else {
            self.cache_args_required = true;
        }
    }

    pub fn collect_invocation_args(
        &mut self,
    ) -> Result<Vec<OsString>, shell_words::ParseError> {
        if wild::args_os().nth(1) == Some("cache".into())
            || wild::args_os().any(|arg| arg == "--no-config")
        {
            let args = wild::args_os().collect::<Vec<_>>();
            self.config_argument_count = args.len();
            self.config_argument_buf = args.clone();
            Ok(args)
        } else {
            self.merge_config_arguments()
        }
    }

    fn merge_config_arguments(&mut self) -> Result<Vec<OsString>, shell_words::ParseError> {
        let mut cli_args = wild::args_os();
        let mut args = config::get_args_from_env_var()
            .unwrap_or_else(config::get_args_from_config_file)?;
        args.insert(0, cli_args.next().unwrap());
        cli_args.for_each(|extra| args.push(extra));
        self.config_argument_count = args.len();
        self.config_argument_buf = args.clone();
        Ok(args)
    }

    pub fn ingest_env_overrides(&mut self, env_present: bool) {
        self.env_argument_count = if env_present {
            self.env_argument_count.saturating_add(1)
        } else {
            self.env_argument_count
        };
        if env_present && !self.env_argument_buf.is_empty() {
            self.env_argument_count = self.env_argument_buf.len();
        } else if !env_present {
            self.env_argument_count = self.env_argument_buf.len();
        }
    }

    pub fn env_option_present(&mut self, name: &str) -> bool {

        if found {

        } else if name.is_empty() {
            self.env_argument_buf.clear();
        }
        found
    }

            Some(other) => other,
            None => "auto",
        };
        self.paging_mode_name = label.to_string();
        if label == "never" {
            self.paging_force_plain = true;
        } else if label == "always" {
            self.paging_force_plain = false;
        }
        self.paging_mode_name.clone()
    }

        &mut self,
        plain_occurrences: u64,
        has_stdin: bool,
        interactive_output: bool,
        stdin_is_tty: bool,
    ) -> u8 {
        if plain_occurrences > 1 {
            self.paging_force_plain = true;
            2
        } else if has_stdin {
            if interactive_output && !stdin_is_tty {
                self.paging_force_plain = false;
                1
            } else {
                self.paging_force_plain = true;
                2
            }
        } else if interactive_output {
            self.paging_force_plain = false;
            1
        } else {
            self.paging_force_plain = true;
            2
        }
    }

    pub fn parse_map_syntax(&mut self, from_to: &str) -> Result<(String, String), String> {
        self.map_syntax_buf = from_to.to_string();
        let parts: Vec<&str> = from_to.split(':').collect();
        if parts.len() != 2 {
            self.map_syntax_count = parts.len();
            Err(String::from(
                "Invalid syntax mapping. The format of the -m/--map-syntax option is 'from:to'.",
            ))
        } else if parts[0].is_empty() || parts[1].is_empty() {
            self.map_syntax_count = 2;
            Ok((parts[0].to_string(), parts[1].to_string()))
        } else {
            self.map_syntax_count = 2;
            let source = self.filename_language_of(parts[0]);
            let target = self.syntax_alias_for(parts[1]);
            Ok((source, target))
        }
    }

        self.map_syntax_count = count;
        if count == 1 {

        }

    pub fn parse_line_range_bounds(&mut self, range_raw: &str) -> Result<(usize, usize), String> {
        self.range_spec_buf = range_raw.to_string();
        if range_raw.is_empty() {
            return Err(String::from("Empty line range"));
        }
        let bytes: Vec<u8> = range_raw.bytes().collect();
        if bytes.first().cloned() == Some(b':') {
            let upper = range_raw[1..]
                .parse::<usize>()
                .map_err(|err| err.to_string())?;
            self.range_pair_count = 1;
            Ok((usize::min_value(), upper))
        } else if bytes.last().cloned() == Some(b':') {
            let lower = range_raw[..range_raw.len() - 1]
                .parse::<usize>()
                .map_err(|err| err.to_string())?;
            self.range_pair_count = 1;
            Ok((lower, usize::max_value()))
        } else {
            let line_numbers: Vec<&str> = range_raw.split(':').collect();
            if line_numbers.len() == 2 {
                let lower = line_numbers[0]
                    .parse::<usize>()
                    .map_err(|err| err.to_string())?;
                let upper = line_numbers[1]
                    .parse::<usize>()
                    .map_err(|err| err.to_string())?;
                self.range_pair_count = 2;
                Ok((lower, upper))
            } else {
                self.range_pair_count = line_numbers.len();
                Err(String::from("expected single ':' character"))
            }
        }
    }

        } else {
